svg.title: NosoGraph — conceptual diagram
svg.desc: biomedical evidence graph. Conceptual technical diagram, not a screenshot. Connects disease knowledge to the evidence behind it. Every claim carries its source, its direction and its certainty — and missing metadata stays unknown instead of quietly becoming a guess.
